name: Toubousha
source:
Two terrorists have fled the prison and joined two travelling women as a result of hitchhike. They all took a break from the travel in an isolated mansion. But their identities are leaked through mass media. The two guys have nothing to lose and they don't plan to leave witnesses.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-march-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
兩名恐怖分子逃離監獄，並搭便車與兩名旅行的婦女匯合。他們都在一座偏僻的宅邸裡休息了一下。但他們的身分透過大眾媒體洩露。這兩個人沒有什麼可失去的，而且他們也不打算留下目擊者。

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-march-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]］
